From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Subject: Fwd: Unexpected spike on April 6 invoice — immediate help requested

Laura/Neha — forwarding Pulse Media's data. Preliminary read from infra: we had an incident between 02:10–02:45 PDT where a downstream retry loop caused a small set of requests to be replayed in quick succession. Our metering layer double-counted several of the replayed frames due to a race in the cache invalidation during failover; this produced inflated token accounting for ~18 minutes.

Proposal: billing team issues a provisional credit for the anomalous window while infra finalizes corrected token counts. Suggest credit = usage delta * 1.0 (i.e., refund the excess tokens) plus a goodwill credit of 10% given the disruption to accounting.

Operational fixes being deployed:
- Patch to metering dedup key to include request-hash + monotonic sequence (hotfix already rolling)
- Add an alert on >3x per-minute variance for a single account across 5-minute rolling windows
- Postmortem + formal RCA to be published by Monday with technical details and preventive actions

Can you confirm we can commit to issuing a provisional credit within 5 business days and follow-up with the corrected invoice? I'll coordinate customer communication once you confirm.

Thanks,
Marcus

What we'll do immediately:
- Issue a provisional credit for the excess usage on the April 6 invoice equal to the calculated overage ($7,430.50). This will appear as a credit line on your account within 5 business days.
- After infra completes the reconciliation (expected by 2027-04-09), we'll replace the provisional credit with a corrected invoice line reflecting the exact token delta. If the final recalculated overage differs, we'll adjust the credit up or down and notify you.
- Publish an incident postmortem and preventive actions (link below) by 2027-04-12.

We appreciate the prompt reporting and apologize for the billing noise. As a goodwill gesture for the effort and disruption, we're adding a one-time platform credit of $1,000 to your account in addition to the overage refund.

Action items for you: please confirm the account id (PM-1147) and let us know whether you'd like the credit applied to the April invoice or kept as a balance to offset May charges.
